about.title: Our story
about.lede: A small café in Al Maather, with unusual hours.
about.p1: DRIPORA is a specialty coffee shop in Al Maather, Riyadh. We open at 5 AM and turn the lights off at 3 AM, so we can be the first coffee of your day or the last one.
about.p2: The menu is short on purpose: espresso and milk drinks, drip coffee on V60 and Chemex, and cold drinks for the Riyadh summer. The pistachio latte, hot or iced, is the house drink.
about.p3: We also have six roasted beans you can take home: three for filter, three for espresso.

visit.title: Visit us
visit.lede: We're in Al Maather, Riyadh. Open every day from fajr until 3 AM.

returns.intro: This policy is carried over from our previous online store and applies to our coffee beans.
returns.p1: You can exchange or return a product within seven days of receiving it. After seven days, exchanges and returns are no longer possible.
returns.p2: The product must be in good condition and unused, and we may inspect it before accepting an exchange or return. Shipping costs for exchanges and returns are paid by the customer; if the product is faulty or we made a mistake, we will make it right.
returns.h3: When exchanges and returns don't apply
returns.p3: If a defect is caused by improper storage or handling, or if the product was prepared to a special request (unless it is faulty or doesn't match what was requested). To start a return, message us on WhatsApp.

privacy.intro: This explains how we handle information when you use our website.
privacy.p1: This website has no accounts and no forms, and doesn't collect personal data. When you order on WhatsApp, we use your number and message only to complete your order, and we keep your personal and contact details strictly confidential.
privacy.p2: The Google map only loads if you ask to see it, at which point Google's privacy policy applies. Orders on WhatsApp are covered by WhatsApp's policy.
privacy.p3: For any question about your privacy, message us on WhatsApp or give us a call.
